wanted_details.heading: Sanctions-designation details
wanted_details.status: Designated by OFAC on January 16, 2025 under Executive Order 13722, program tag DPRK3, for acting or purporting to act for or on behalf of Chonsurim Trading Corporation

details.label: Linked to
details.value: Chonsurim Trading Corporation, a.k.a. Korea Chonsurim Trading Corporation

wanted_details.caution: Jong In Chol is the president of Chonsurim's DPRK IT worker delegation in Laos, the revenue of which is used exclusively to support the DPRK's munitions sector. Since at least 2021, Department 53 front company Chonsurim Trading Corporation has directed a group of DPRK IT workers in Laos to use falsified identification credentials to undertake software development and other IT work for companies around the world.
